slides.head: What is left for you
slides.say: Good morning, Steven. This is what is left for you, with the most urgent first, and one card for each.

slides.head: Settle the conflicts
points: Settle the conflicts and open questions
slides.say: First, the JMP review of the AI washing paper. The merged notes page is ready, and what remains is for you to settle the conflicts between the notes and answer the open questions. This one is due around November fourteenth.

slides.head: UT Dallas for Jawadul
points: Link is in the Nov 7 email
slides.say: Second, the UT Dallas recommendation letter for Jawadul. It is due November fifteenth, and the link is in the admissions email from November seventh. The UTA letter is done, and Washington State may still need another try in GradCAS.

slides.head: Approve or submit R3
points: Jack says the draft is ready
slides.say: Third, the third revision for the Journal of Management Education with Bob, Jack and Sally. Jack says the draft is ready, so your job is to approve it or submit it, by about November eighteenth.

slides.head: Send one assignment
slides.say: Fourth, the AI-Aware Assignments Showcase. They need one assignment from you by November eighteenth.

slides.head: Approve the decisions
slides.say: Fifth, the Amazon nuclear case copyedit from Ivey. Every comment has been walked through, so you only need to approve the decisions, and then Claude applies them.

slides.head: Read, then send
slides.say: Sixth, the innovation and industry paper, version fifteen. Read the rewritten paragraph and the draft email to the team, and then send it.

slides.head: Reply to Ray and Nils
slides.say: Seventh, Same Tools. Absorptive capacity moderates headcount but not productivity, and Ray and Nils are waiting on your reply.

slides.head: Pick a version
points: Tell Alisa, Chad, Sanwar your bandwidth
slides.say: Eighth, the ecosystem paper with Alisa. Pick Version B with its three conditions, or Version A, and tell Alisa, Chad and Sanwar how much bandwidth you have. The proposal is due in January.

slides.head: Read Dana's comments
points: Read them with Mike and Steve
slides.say: Ninth, the CEO characteristics paper. Read Dana's comments together with Mike and Steve.

slides.head: Read one board
slides.say: Tenth, the Principals game. The round packets are now at Jensen length. Read one board for tone, and then Claude wires it in and redoes the video.

slides.head: Carmen is waiting
slides.say: Last, Carmen at Southfork. A reply draft is waiting in Gmail, so review it and send it. That is everything, and thanks for watching.
